description: This file defines a React functional component for managing tags, including viewing, creating, editing, deleting tags, and fetching related model info. It includes UI elements like modals, buttons, and tables, and handles API calls for tag operations.

classes.name: TagProps
classes.description: Props interface for TagManagement component, including accessToken, userID, userRole.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: Interface representing model information including name, parameters, and ID.

methods.name: fetchTags
methods.description: Fetches list of tags from backend API and updates state.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers fetchTags and updates lastRefreshed timestamp.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new tag via API call, then refreshes tag list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a tag by setting state.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and executes tag deletion via API, then refreshes list.
